answer: Screen each claimant with a private, freshly minted micro-probe no template can predict, then judge submissions by correlated mistakes, not identical wording. Weights shape blind spots, so ten cloned bodies fail alike and count as one head; a clone cannot fake a distinct error profile on an unpredictable probe, it must know what its siblings lack. Each head reaches its own horizon of distinct knowledge, and a probe is minted for one key, never carried across a bridge to a sibling. The scarce input is a separate mind, one per head; a hollow arch is not a bridge.
